description: This file contains a shell script function that performs a data check during a failsafe upgrade process for U-Boot on certain embedded devices. It handles image size, checksum calculations, environment variable updates, and flashing process management for kernel and root filesystem partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Performs a failsafe data check and upgrade process, including calculating image sizes and checksums, updating environment variables, and flashing kernel and root filesystem images.
